nodes.label: Authorized Testing Disclaimer
nodes.rationale: BLE Suite documents itself as for authorized testing and educational purposes only; success varies by target device, firmware, and patch level, and modern/patched devices resist most attacks.

nodes.label: Protocol Definition Centralization
nodes.rationale: Before this directory existed, RF protocol timing/preset data was scattered and duplicated across rf_send.cpp, rf_scan.cpp, and utilities; the refactor goal is that any protocol addition happens here and consumers (send, scan, replay) read from these definitions instead of redefining parameters.

nodes.label: KeeLoq Rolling Code Coverage
nodes.rationale: Cipher is byte-identical to the reference algorithm (NLF, 528 rounds); ported from and validated against the Flipper Zero and Momentum firmware KeeLoq implementations, with matching type ids so a /mfcodes exported from either firmware works verbatim.
